idea-plugin.name: Codex App Launcher [Beta]
idea-plugin.description:
English

Codex App Launcher [Beta] connects IntelliJ IDEA with the Codex desktop app, making it easier to open projects and send precise code references without manually copying file paths or line numbers.

Platform support: Opening Codex App supports Windows and macOS. Sending code or file references currently supports Windows only; macOS reference sending is not supported yet.

  • Open the current IntelliJ IDEA project directly in Codex App from the main toolbar.
  • Send selected code with its project-relative file path and exact line range on Windows.
  • Send the selected code reference, or the current file reference when there is no selection, from the editor context menu using Send to Codex App.
  • Append references to the current Codex App input without automatically submitting the message.
  • Customize the Windows PowerShell launch command in the IDE settings.

Project paths are resolved to their real absolute locations before Codex App is launched. Project launching supports Windows and macOS. Reference insertion currently supports Windows only.

中文

Codex App Launcher [Beta] 用于连接 IntelliJ IDEA 与 Codex 桌面应用， 让开发者无需手动复制文件路径和行号，即可快速打开项目并发送准确的代码引用。

平台支持：打开 Codex App 支持 Windows 和 macOS；发送代码或文件引用目前仅支持 Windows，暂不支持 macOS 引用发送。

  • 通过 IDEA 主工具栏直接在 Codex App 中打开当前项目。
  • 在 Windows 上发送选中的代码，并自动携带项目相对路径和准确行号范围。
  • 通过编辑器右键菜单中的 Send to Codex App 发送选中的代码引用；未选中代码时发送当前文件引用。
  • 引用只会追加到 Codex App 当前输入框，不会自动提交消息。
  • 可以在 IDEA 设置中自定义 Windows PowerShell 启动命令。

插件会先将项目路径解析为真实绝对路径，再启动 Codex App。 项目启动支持 Windows 和 macOS；当前引用追加仅支持 Windows。
